problem.family:text.features: character n-grams (2 to 5) of the person's words and answers, tf-idf; logistic regression, balanced

limits: Measured on dev rows of journeys: written people played through the Home conversation on the rules alone, each label the set of answers its journey accepts (workflow_labels_v2); the sealed journeys are read once, under the gate fixed before.
A group is a person (a set and an id): dev holds other people of the same problem kinds, so dev measures reading these kinds of conversation, not real sessions, whose words and order vary more.
On dev the rules' answer counts right when the journey accepts it, the classifier's only when it is the label it learned (the first accepted); the sealed gate counts every accepted answer for both.

The state is what the ledger records (counts, flags and codes, never the person's words): a classifier sees less than the rules, which read the words; matching the rules is the expected result until real sessions accumulate.
The new people are written by Claude through the gateway (S8 B1): invented, varied on purpose; a student may learn the writer's style; the sealed people are written by a separate agent to test that.
